title: [BUG]: Authorization-code token exchange ignores `token_endpoint_auth_method`,   breaking DCR with strict OAuth 2.1 providers (e.g. Datadog)
reasoning:
other providers don't trip this

  Auth0, Okta, Google, Microsoft, etc. accept either form for clients registered as
  `client_secret_basic` — they're lenient per RFC 6749 §2.3.1. Datadog (and presumably other strict
  OAuth 2.1 servers) enforce the registered method. The mismatch is invisible until ContextForge meets
   a strict server.
